sql.if: SELECT 'ITEM' AS hit_type, i.id AS id, i.title AS title, COALESCE(i.description, '') AS detail, i.project_id AS project_id, p.name AS project_name, i.updated_at AS updated_at FROM item i LEFT JOIN project p ON p.id = i.project_id WHERE i.title ILIKE #{like} OR i.description ILIKE #{like}

SELECT 'PROJECT' AS hit_type, pr.id AS id, pr.name AS title, COALESCE(pr.description, '') AS detail, NULL::BIGINT AS project_id, NULL::VARCHAR AS project_name, pr.updated_at AS updated_at FROM project pr WHERE pr.name ILIKE #{like} OR pr.description ILIKE #{like}

SELECT 'DAILY' AS hit_type, d.id AS id, TO_CHAR(d.daily_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS title, COALESCE(d.content, '') AS detail, NULL::BIGINT AS project_id, NULL::VARCHAR AS project_name, d.updated_at AS updated_at FROM daily d WHERE d.content ILIKE #{like}
